summary: MCI v3.0 implementation verified end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_mci_v3_0.py with 11 pytest cases covering sufficiency gate (fresh session → awaiting; +1 version + 5 events still awaiting; +1 ack → analyzed), analyzed status on sess_96285667fb26, documentation_share sums to ≈1.0, disclaimer contains 'does not determine legal ownership' AND 'does not assign publishing splits', stamp_versions_mci_status flips every version to 'analyzed' while confidence_status stays frozen at 'awaiting_evidence_analysis', voice-moment attribution safety (only confirmed/corrected contribute to attribution; disputed/unconfirmed count as human signals only), and 401 for unauthenticated access. All 11 MCI tests + 26 CEI + 16 auto-doc + 19 voice-evidence tests PASS (72/72). Frontend: logged in as test@songright.com, navigated to /sessions/sess_96285667fb26/studio → WRITE chapter → Evolution → Documentary view, clicked a version card and confirmed the new MUSICAL CONTRIBUTION INTELLIGENCE™ section renders inside VersionDetailSheet between CONTINUITY and INTEGRITY, with data-testid='mci-panel-analyzed', contributor initials/name/documentation-share % (bold right-aligned) + colored category chips (Lyric·61, Harmony·12, Production·35, Identifier·19, Acknowledgements·88, Confirmed Voice Moments·22), the mci-disclaimer containing the required legal-ownership phrase, and the mci-refresh-btn triggering a re-render successfully.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: DialogTitle missing for a11y ('DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'). Pre-existing sheet accessibility gap — wrap the sheet title in VisuallyHidden or add explicit DialogTitle. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add a DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden ok) to the VersionDetailSheet Radix DialogContent to silence the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: mci.py::_human_signal_count also counts 'disputed'/'annotated' voice moments toward the sufficiency-gate human_signals — this matches spec (human-in-the-loop), and attribution correctly excludes them; both branches are verified by test_voice_moment_attribution_only_confirmed_corrected.

GET /api/sessions/{sid}/mci and POST /mci/refresh both call stamp_versions_mci_status, which will flip mci_status on every read. This is compute-on-demand as documented — acceptable but note it means any prior test that hard-asserted mci_status == 'awaiting_musical_contribution_analysis' will fail after the first read. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_cei_v2.py::test_get_list_hydrated to accept mci_status ∈ {awaiting, analyzed} per review-request 'other_misc_info' guidance.
MciAnalysisPanel: useEffect load() dependency comment disables react-hooks/exhaustive-deps — flagged as out-of-scope per reviewer note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI acceptance criteria for MCI panel verified live)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created a fresh session per test via POST /api/sessions with title 'TEST_MCI_fresh_*'; added 1 version + 5 TEST_MCI lyric lines + 1 signature acknowledgement to exercise the sufficiency gate. Voice attribution test inserts a synthetic sess_mcitest_* + version + 5 events + a voice_evidence doc with 3 moments (confirmed / disputed / unconfirmed) directly via motor and tears them down at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MCI v3.0 fully green. Key selectors: WRITE chapter = [data-testid=studio-chapter-write]; Evolution sub-tab = [data-testid=studio-tab-evolution]; Documentary view = get_by_text('Documentary'); version cards = [data-testid^='evolution-version-']; MCI panel testids = mci-panel-analyzed / mci-panel-awaiting / mci-disclaimer / mci-refresh-btn / mci-contributor-{user_id}. The seed session sess_96285667fb26 currently has 52 versions / 49 artifacts / 88 acks / 3 contributors / 237 signals / 123 human-in-the-loop signals — HIGH documentation coverage. Any test that hard-pins mci_status='awaiting_musical_contribution_analysis' will fail after the first GET /mci because stamp_versions_mci_status flips it — assert IN ('awaiting_musical_contribution_analysis', 'analyzed') for generic checks. confidence_status remains frozen at 'awaiting_evidence_analysis' — regression assertion in test_mci_stamps_version_mci_status.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verified. One prior test (test_cei_v2.py::test_get_list_hydrated) failed after MCI landed because it hard-pinned mci_status; per review-request guidance this is expected new behaviour and the assertion was widened to accept either awaiting or analyzed.
